what_was_found: A sign-in with a staff-shown code silently resolved to an EXISTING Client with that address and inherited its live entitlement, client group and a 30-day remembered device.

A chargeback counted towards a 'full refund' (refunds and chargebacks were summed), and Stripe booked every non-inquiry dispute as a chargeback, including open and won ones; card settlements had no review case.
Nothing reacted to a full provider refund: the access it paid for stayed on.
The Phase-4 harness ran none of the card reversal, LIVE-refusal, sealing, conversion or free-to-paid tests (no -run filter matched them).
The site-wide mail allowlist opened the services behind mail providers' addresses to every pre-auth device while the per-device temporary window already served the device that asked.
Code requests showed full addresses and hardware addresses to every role that could read the list.
An SMTP unit test expected a plain-ASCII Subject to be MIME-encoded; Go leaves it unencoded.
Automated harness runs had left 91 live test entitlements (e2e-/md- accounts, the e2e voucher batch).
delivered: Staff-assisted verification (migration 0114): each reveal recorded before the code leaves; an existing Client is never reached (refused at reveal, refused and rolled back at verification); a new Client's factor is marked staff_assisted, matches no client-group rule, earns no remembered device, is labelled *_OTP_ASSISTED; the client's own later proof clears the marker; fails closed.

Code requests: full address and device only for roles that may show a code (masked for others, fail closed); existing clients flagged; the portal tells a client when a withheld window returns (six languages).

Refund policy (migration 0115): a full refund ends only the funded entitlement (REVOKED, devices and sessions closed, append-only evidence, idempotent); partial refunds and UNKNOWN never act; disputes and chargebacks open a case decided once by a payments operator (Keep / End access, password, reason, audit; cases refuse deletion and change after a decision); Stripe books a chargeback only for a lost dispute.
The mail allowlist is not applied while temporary internet is on.

HTTPS for the portal investigated and designed; not deliverable inside this authorisation (public hostname, certificate issuance path and the recorded no-portal-PKI decision are Product-Owner decisions).
